CellCanon: An Agentic Cellular World Model for Prediction, Explanation, and Observation-Driven Updating. Graph-Mediated Large Language Model Systems in the Agentic Era: Reasoning, Knowledge, Retrieval, Execution, and Coordination. Graph-Mediated Large Language Model Systems in the Agentic Era: Reasoning, Knowledge, Retrieval, Execution, and Coordination Graphs play an increasingly important role in large language model (LLM) systems, supporting structural reasoning, knowledge grounding, retrieval, and memory.

SleuthVLM: Do We Really Need Audio-in-Video for Omni Video Understanding?. SleuthVLM: Do We Really Need Audio-in-Video for Omni Video Understanding? Omni models answer questions about videos by jointly processing sampled frames and audio in one turn, with progress driven largely by scaling model size and omni training data.
